request_summary: Phase 2 CLV-BACKFILL resume - first launch produced unusable results; diagnosed via heartbeat, fixed, relaunched.
scope_completed: First-launch diagnosis: ALL scrape outputs contained only 1 record (expected 100+). Three root causes found and fixed
Fix 1: scrape timeout_s 1500 (25 min) -> 7200 (2 h). Full-season scrape measured ~13 s/match (~380 matches = ~85 min) - the old timeout killed every job mid-run

Fix 2: partial-output guard (MIN_RECORDS=20) - CLI timeouts / Node driver crashes had left 1-record JSONs that the >100-byte check wrongly accepted as complete; partial outputs now quarantined to .partial.json and re-scraped
Fix 3: per-worker state files (state.json for w1, state-w2.json for w2) - both workers previously clobbered the shared state.json, losing worker 1 checkpoints
Argparse fix retained: --league is action=append now (first launch silently ran only the LAST league per worker)
DB integrity verified: afb_odds_snapshots rows with run_id='clv_backfill_batch1' = 0 - no polluted data was written
Both workers relaunched at ~19:04 with fixed script (quiet-bloom w1, quick-bison w2)

findings.title: Full-season scrape pace measured
evidence: ~13 s/match with all bookmakers; ~380 matches/league-season = ~85 min; 22 jobs / 2 workers = ~15-16 h total

findings.title: Node.js driver crash observed in one scrape
evidence: england-premier-league_2023-2024.log ends with Node.js v24.22.1 crash dump after 112 matches scraped

findings.title: State clobber race confirmed
evidence: state.json contained only worker 2 entries (La Liga errors); worker 1 entries lost on every worker 2 save

actions_taken: Killed both workers + CLI children; archived 6 partial JSONs as .partial.bak + state as state.pre-fix.bak
Patched scripts/clv_backfill.py (timeout, MIN_RECORDS guard, rc check, per-worker state); py_compile passed
Relaunched both workers with correct multi-league args

verification.check: DB not polluted by partial scrapes
verification.evidence: SELECT COUNT(*) afb_odds_snapshots WHERE run_id='clv_backfill_batch1' -> 0 rows, 0 matches

risks: Node driver crash may recur on long scrapes - the MIN_RECORDS guard will catch it and the job will be re-scraped on next run
~15-16 h total runtime expected; per-job checkpoints make it fully resumable
recommended_next_actions: Monitor worker completion (~15-16 h); integrate scraped/mapped/inserted/no-match totals; write final artifact + handoff
handoff_to_main: Phase 2 first-launch produced only partial scrapes (3 tool bugs, all fixed; DB unaffected - 0 rows written). Workers relaunched 19:04 with 2h timeout + partial guard + per-worker state; ETA ~15-16 h for all 22 league-seasons. Will handoff on completion.
